title: Storybook 与文档化
html:
Storybook 与文档化

核心概念

Storybook 是组件驱动开发（Component-Driven Development）的核心工具。它为每个组件提供独立的开发和展示环境，让开发者可以在隔离状态下构建、测试和文档化组件。

graph TD
    SB[Storybook]
    SB --> DEV[开发环境<br/>组件隔离开发]
    SB --> DOC[活文档<br/>自动生成 API 文档]
    SB --> TEST[测试平台<br/>视觉测试 + 交互测试]
    SB --> COLLAB[协作工具<br/>设计师 / PM / 开发者]

Storybook 配置

基础配置

// .storybook/main.ts
import type { StorybookConfig } from '@storybook/react-vite';

const config: StorybookConfig = {
  stories: ['../src/**/*.stories.@(ts|tsx)'],
  addons: [
    '@storybook/addon-essentials',
    '@storybook/addon-interactions',
    '@storybook/addon-a11y',
    '@storybook/addon-links',
  ],
  framework: {
    name: '@storybook/react-vite',
    options: {},
  },
  docs: {
    autodocs: 'tag',
  },
  typescript: {
    reactDocgen: 'react-docgen-typescript',
    reactDocgenTypescriptOptions: {
      shouldExtractLiteralValuesFromEnum: true,
      propFilter: (prop) => (prop.parent ? !/node_modules/.test(prop.parent.fileName) : true),
    },
  },
};

export default config;

全局装饰器

// .storybook/preview.ts
import type { Preview } from "@storybook/react";
import { ThemeProvider } from "../src/providers/ThemeProvider";
import "../src/styles/globals.css";

const preview: Preview = {
  parameters: {
    actions: { argTypesRegex: "^on[A-Z].*" },
    controls: {
      matchers: {
        color: /(background|color)$/i,
        date: /Date$/i,
      },
    },
    layout: "centered",
  },
  decorators: [
    (Story) => (
      <ThemeProvider>
        <div className="p-8">
          <Story />
        </div>
      </ThemeProvider>
    ),
  ],
};

export default preview;

编写 Stories

Button Stories

// src/components/Button/Button.stories.tsx
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react";
import { fn } from "@storybook/test";
import { Button } from "./Button";

const meta = {
  title: "Components/Button",
  component: Button,
  tags: ["autodocs"],
  args: {
    onClick: fn(),
    children: "按钮",
  },
  argTypes: {
    variant: {
      control: "select",
      options: ["primary", "secondary", "danger", "ghost", "outline"],
      description: "按钮样式变体",
    },
    size: {
      control: "select",
      options: ["sm", "md", "lg"],
      description: "按钮尺寸",
    },
    loading: {
      control: "boolean",
      description: "加载状态",
    },
    disabled: {
      control: "boolean",
      description: "禁用状态",
    },
  },
} satisfies Meta<typeof Button>;

export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>;

export const Primary: Story = {
  args: {
    variant: "primary",
    children: "主要按钮",
  },
};

export const Secondary: Story = {
  args: {
    variant: "secondary",
    children: "次要按钮",
  },
};

export const Danger: Story = {
  args: {
    variant: "danger",
    children: "危险按钮",
  },
};

export const AllSizes: Story = {
  render: () => (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
      <Button size="sm">小尺寸</Button>
      <Button size="md">中尺寸</Button>
      <Button size="lg">大尺寸</Button>
    </div>
  ),
};

export const AllVariants: Story = {
  render: () => (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
      <Button variant="primary">Primary</Button>
      <Button variant="secondary">Secondary</Button>
      <Button variant="danger">Danger</Button>
      <Button variant="ghost">Ghost</Button>
      <Button variant="outline">Outline</Button>
    </div>
  ),
};

export const Loading: Story = {
  args: {
    loading: true,
    children: "提交中...",
  },
};

export const Disabled: Story = {
  args: {
    disabled: true,
    children: "不可用",
  },
};

export const WithIcons: Story = {
  render: () => (
    <div className="flex gap-4">
      <Button leftIcon={<span>📎</span>}>上传文件</Button>
      <Button rightIcon={<span>→</span>}>下一步</Button>
    </div>
  ),
};

交互测试

Storybook 的 play 函数允许在 Story 中编写交互测试，使用与 Testing Library 相同的 API。

// src/components/LoginForm/LoginForm.stories.tsx
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react';
import { within, userEvent, expect, fn } from '@storybook/test';
import { LoginForm } from './LoginForm';

const meta = {
  title: 'Features/LoginForm',
  component: LoginForm,
  tags: ['autodocs'],
} satisfies Meta<typeof LoginForm>;

export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>;

export const Default: Story = {
  args: {
    onSubmit: fn(),
  },
};

export const FilledForm: Story = {
  args: {
    onSubmit: fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
  },
  play: async ({ canvasElement, args }) => {
    const canvas = within(canvasElement);

    await userEvent.type(canvas.getByLabelText('邮箱'), 'test@example.com');
    await userEvent.type(canvas.getByLabelText('密码'), 'password123');
    await userEvent.click(canvas.getByRole('button', { name: '登录' }));

    await expect(args.onSubmit).toHaveBeenCalledWith('test@example.com', 'password123');
  },
};

export const ErrorState: Story = {
  args: {
    onSubmit: fn().mockRejectedValue(new Error('认证失败')),
  },
  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
    const canvas = within(canvasElement);

    await userEvent.type(canvas.getByLabelText('邮箱'), 'wrong@example.com');
    await userEvent.type(canvas.getByLabelText('密码'), 'wrong');
    await userEvent.click(canvas.getByRole('button', { name: '登录' }));

    await expect(canvas.findByRole('alert')).resolves.toHaveTextContent('认证失败');
  },
};

自动文档生成

Storybook 的 autodocs 功能自动从 TypeScript 类型定义生成组件 API 文档。

flowchart LR
    TS[TypeScript Props 接口] --> DOCGEN[react-docgen-typescript]
    DOCGEN --> TABLE[Props 表格]
    STORIES[Stories 定义] --> EXAMPLES[使用示例]
    TABLE --> AUTODOC[自动生成的文档页]
    EXAMPLES --> AUTODOC

通过为 Props 添加 JSDoc 注释，可以丰富自动生成的文档：

interface ButtonProps {
  /** 按钮的样式变体 */
  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'danger' | 'ghost' | 'outline';
  /** 按钮尺寸 */
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  /** 是否处于加载状态 */
  loading?: boolean;
  /** 按钮左侧图标 */
  leftIcon?: React.ReactNode;
  /** 按钮右侧图标 */
  rightIcon?: React.ReactNode;
  /** 点击事件处理函数 */
  onClick?: (event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void;
  /** 按钮内容 */
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

组件文档最佳实践

实践 说明
每个组件至少一个 Story 展示组件的默认状态
覆盖所有 Variant 展示所有样式变体和尺寸组合
展示交互状态 Loading、Disabled、Error 等状态
包含使用示例 展示组件在实际场景中的用法
添加 play 函数 验证组件的交互行为
启用 a11y 检查 @storybook/addon-a11y 自动检测可访问性问题

Storybook 在 CI 中的集成

name: Storybook CI
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  storybook:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'pnpm'
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build Storybook
        run: pnpm run build-storybook

      - name: Run Storybook Tests
        run: |
          npx concurrently -k -s first -n "SB,TEST" \
            "npx http-server storybook-static --port 6006 --silent" \
            "npx wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:6006 && pnpm run test-storybook"

      - name: Deploy to Chromatic
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: chromaui/action@latest
        with:
          projectToken: ${{ secrets.CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN }}
          storybookBuildDir: storybook-static

小结

  • Storybook 是组件驱动开发的核心工具——兼具开发、文档、测试和协作功能。
  • 通过 autodocs 和 TypeScript 类型定义自动生成组件 API 文档。
  • play 函数让 Story 同时承担展示和交互测试的职责。
  • 每个组件应覆盖所有 Variant、尺寸和交互状态的 Stories。
  • Storybook 可与 CI 流水线和 Chromatic 集成，实现自动化构建和视觉测试。
